inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2026E owner FCF, built from Q2-2026 actuals plus company Q3 guidance, NOT the FY2025 base the June model used. H1-2026 FCF was $2,150.0m (Q1 1,286.7 + Q2 863.3). Carrying the guided Q3 (rev 2,055-2,085, adj EBITDA 1,710-1,740) and holding Q4 at the guided QoQ pace gives FY2026E revenue ~$8,064m and adj EBITDA ~$6,745m. H1 realised FCF/adjEBITDA conversion was 0.678 (=> FY26 FCF ~4,573m, only +15.7% on FY2025); FY2025 conversion was 0.876 (=> 5,909m, +49.5%). Base takes partial normalisation at 0.75 => $5,059m, +28.0% on FY2025's $3,952m.

historical_growth.revenue_3yr_note: FY2022->FY2025 raw CAGR; DISTORTED — FY2022-FY2024 are total-company (Advertising + Apps), FY2025 is advertising-only. Understates real growth. Do NOT use for projections.
historical_growth.revenue_5yr_note: Not meaningful — FY2021 total-company vs FY2025 advertising-only comparison is invalid.
historical_growth.advertising_revenue_1yr_note: FY2024 advertising-only (~$3,216M) to FY2025 advertising-only ($5,481M). Like-for-like growth.
historical_growth.advertising_revenue_q1_yoy_note: Q1 2025 advertising (~$1,159M) to Q1 2026 ($1,842M). Most recent like-for-like quarterly growth.
historical_growth.eps_note: FY2023->FY2025 2-year CAGR of 215%. Distorted by massive profitability inflection. FY2022 EPS was negative. FY2024->FY2025: +115%. Explosive but decelerating from a low base.
historical_growth.fcf_note: FY2025 FCF $3,952.0m (+91% YoY). H1-2026 FCF $2,150.0m, only +12.4% on the Q2 half and -32.9% QoQ in Q2 alone. The deceleration is cash-conversion, not demand: H1-2026 OCF/NI fell to 87% from 115% a year earlier on a $504.8m working-capital build (AR -352.6, accrued liabs -125.0), vs $140.3m in H1-2025. DSO nonetheless IMPROVED to 105 days from 121, so this reads as growth funding rather than deteriorating collection quality -- which is why the base case normalises it only partly.
historical_growth.equity_cagr_note: Equity CAGR is meaningless for AppLovin. Pre-IPO equity was a stockholders deficit (-$130M Q1 2021). Post-IPO equity has been distorted by aggressive buybacks (~$1B/quarter in late 2025 and Q1 2026), which reduce book value. Equity went from $2,138M (FY2021) to $2,135M (FY2025) while the business grew 11x on FCF — the CAGR would show ~0% growth on a fundamentally transformed business. For this company, FCF is the correct growth anchor.
historical_growth.growth_rate_rationale: Year 1 base growth of 24% off an FY2026E base of $5,059m. The June model's 40% off FY2025 is now falsified by H1 actuals: it required FY2026 FCF of $5,532.8m, of which H1 delivered $2,150.0m (38.9%), implying an H2 that grows ~96% QoQ from Q2's $863.3m. Revenue is not the problem -- Q2 grew 53% YoY and Q3 is guided to +47% YoY -- FCF conversion is.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Revenue and FCF have decoupled. FY2026E revenue growth is ~47% but FY2026E FCF growth is +16% to +49% depending entirely on whether the working-capital build reverses. This single assumption spans the whole scenario range; treat any APP FCF projection that does not state its conversion assumption as unusable.

wacc_rationale: Base 11%, unchanged in level from the June model but NOT for the same reasons. The June rationale leaned on 'active SEC and FTC regulatory investigations'; the Q2-2026 10-Q Item 1 discloses no such proceeding -- only the March-2025 securities class action (motion to dismiss fully briefed Feb-2026) and a consolidated derivative suit stayed behind it. The remaining premium over a mega-cap is for realised beta (the stock has had five separate one-day moves beyond +/-13% in twelve months), key-person concentration in CEO Adam Foroughi, and single-model dependence on AXON with no contractual lock-in. Bear 12% retained for litigation plus a conversion regime that does not normalise; bull 10%.

base.growth_rate_rationale: Year 1: 40% (below current ~56% run-rate; moderating from the FY2024->FY2025 +70% surge as scale increases). Year 2: 32% (e-commerce ramp continues but early easy comparables pass). Year 3: 24% (self-service platform matures, growth normalizes). Year 4: 17% (business reaches larger scale, gaming vertical matures). Year 5: 12% (approaching but above terminal; e-commerce still growing). Cumulative 5-year CAGR implicit: ~24%.

bull.growth_rate_rationale: Year 1: 50% (consistent with current Q1 2026 trajectory; e-commerce ramp accelerates per CEO's '4x' commentary and self-service global launch). Year 2: 42% (material AXON model upgrades deliver continued step-changes in advertiser ROAS across e-commerce). Year 3-5: gradual deceleration as the company becomes a dominant multi-vertical platform. Aligned with bull_case: e-commerce TAM dwarfs gaming, self-service flywheel drives non-linear advertiser growth, AXON data advantage compounds.

bear.growth_rate_rationale: Year 1: 22% (regulatory actions force changes to data collection/identifier bridging, degrading AXON targeting efficacy; advertiser ROAS deteriorates). Year 2: 14% (multiple-compression forces revenue guidance cuts; gaming vertical stagnates). Year 3-5: rapid deceleration as e-commerce expansion stalls (advertisers revert to Meta/Google) and regulatory consent decrees limit data practices. Aligned with bear_case: SEC/FTC investigations result in material restrictions, securities litigation settlement, and valuation re-rating.

sensitivity.matrix_note: Rows = WACC (9% to 13%), Columns = Terminal Growth Rate (2.0% to 4.0%). Values are intrinsic value per share in USD. Base case is WACC=11%, TG=3.0% = $359/share.

probability_weighted.weight_rationale: Equal bull/bear weighting at 25% each with 50% base reflects: the regulatory investigations are material but not certain to result in impairment (bear not dominant); the e-commerce ramp is real but early-stage and not yet proven at scale (bull not dominant). The base case captures the most likely central path of moderating but substantial growth.

sanity_check.method: Implied multiples at base-case IV vs. historical trading multiples and growth context

current_price_multiples.note: Recomputed on FY2026E (rev ~8,064, adj EBITDA ~6,745, FCF base case 5,059) and the Q2-2026 balance sheet.

base_iv_implied_multiples.fy2026_estimates_basis: FY2026 estimates: NI ~$5.5B, Rev ~$7.7B, EBITDA ~$6.6B, FCF ~$5.5B (based on Q1 2026 run-rate and ~55% YoY growth trajectory)

historical_context.historical_pe_note: APP was unprofitable through FY2022 (negative NI), limiting historical P/E comparability. The stock's re-rating from ~$10 (Dec 2022) to ~$467 (Jun 2026) reflects a genuine earnings inflection: FY2022 NI was -$193M, FY2025 NI was +$3.3B. Historical trading ranges are not a useful anchor; the business is fundamentally different.

peg_analysis.peg_note: All scenarios produce PEG ratios below 1.0x, which is conventionally considered 'growth at a reasonable price.' At current price, PEG of 0.59x (using ~56% FCF growth) suggests the market is not pricing in irrationally exuberant future growth, but rather a continuation of the current trajectory. The base-case DCF IV of $359 implies PEG of 0.40x — indicating our model is conservative relative to current market pricing.

sanity_check_verdict.reason: Base IV $302.46 sits -3.3% from $312.63 and the weighted IV is $316.06 -- the model and the market now agree, where in June the model sat 23% BELOW a $467 price. The stock has since fallen 33%.
sanity_check_verdict.nuance: At $312.63 the market implies ~14.8% sustained FCF growth off the FY2026E base, against a company guiding Q3 revenue +47% YoY. That gap is the investment case and the warning at once: either conversion normalises and the shares are worth more, or the market is right that 2026's cash generation is what a larger, slower AppLovin actually looks like. The 2026-08-06 reaction (-19.7% on 15.2m shares) came on a quarter that BEAT on revenue, net income and EBITDA -- the market repriced the cash conversion and the guide, not a demand miss.
sanity_check_verdict.value_investor_conclusion: Fairly valued, not cheap. The +17.8% upside carried in the screen was a June model marked to an August price; rebuilt on H1-2026 actuals it is -3.3%. No action warranted at $312.63.

valuation_philosophy: Rebuilt 2026-08-28 after Q2-2026. The June model was not wrong in structure -- its engine reproduces to the cent -- it was stale in its base year, and the price refresh of 2026-08-12 updated the price without touching the projection, leaving a +17.8% upside that was really a June intrinsic value divided by an August price. The single load-bearing assumption was Year-1 FCF growth of 40% off FY2025; H1-2026 actuals falsify it, requiring an H2 that nearly doubles sequentially. Rebasing onto an FY2026E built from reported H1 plus company guidance moves the base case from +16% to -3%. Two findings cut against the bear: DSO improved (121 -> 105 days), so the working-capital build is growth funding rather than collection deterioration; and the SEC/FTC investigations the June bear case rested on are absent from the Q2 10-Q's legal proceedings. The remaining question is narrow and cash-flow-shaped: does FCF/EBITDA conversion return toward FY2025's 0.876 or stay near H1-2026's 0.678? Base assumes 0.75.
